grades.overall_note: The agent handled the case well: it reopened the ticket, brought back the same provider, updated both parties and set a follow-up. It falls short on three points. It never told Lantern that the return visit should be free under the workmanship guarantee (it even invited a quote). It did not hold the invoice pending the return visit. It did not ask Lantern to report what they find.
